script_crashed.title: Altium's script engine seems stuck or crashed
steps: Switch to Altium Designer.
Press Ctrl+F3 (Run > Stop Script). If a script debugger is paused, stop it there.
If Altium still does not respond, save your work and restart Altium.
Come back here and press Retry.

eda_loop_active.title: eda-agent is still holding Altium's scripting engine
steps: Easiest: in Claude, ask it to call the eda-agent tool app_detach (do not use any other Altium tool). It SAVES all modified Altium documents first.
Or, if you do not want anything saved: in Altium press Ctrl+F3 to stop the running script (StartMCPServer).
Wait about 5 seconds, then press Retry.

eda_loop_not_started.title: eda-agent loop is not running in Altium
steps: In Altium: File > Run Script...
Choose StartMCPServer (from the eda-agent script project) and run it.
A small eda-agent status window should appear.
If it is missing: DXP > Preferences > Scripting System > Global Projects > add the eda-agent script project (the folder printed by 'eda-agent install-scripts').
Press Retry.

altium_not_running.title: Altium Designer is not running
steps: Start Altium Designer.
Open the project you want to work on (File > Open).
Press Retry.

eco_dialog.title: The schematic-to-PCB update (ECO) needs you
steps: In Altium look for the Engineering Change Order dialog (it may be behind other windows).
Click Validate Changes, then Execute Changes, then Close.
Press Retry.

wrong_document.title: The wrong Altium document is in focus
steps: In Altium, open the .PcbDoc (or .SchDoc) the tool needs.
Click its tab so it is the focused document.
Press Retry.

library_open.title: A library file is open in Altium
steps: In Altium, close the .SchLib / .PcbLib that is being edited (save it first).
Press Retry. Reopen the library in Altium after the offline tool finishes.

unsaved_docs.title: Altium has unsaved documents
steps: In Altium choose File > Save All.
Press Retry.

unknown_modal.title: Altium is not answering - a dialog may be hiding
steps: Look at the taskbar and behind other windows for an Altium dialog box.
Close or answer the dialog.
Press Retry.

restart_needed.title: The bridge could not recover - restart needed
steps: Save everything in Altium, then close and reopen Altium.
If the loop check is giving wrong answers, you can skip it with:  bridge.cmd force coffee   or   bridge.cmd force eda
Ask Claude to try again.

kill_engaged.title: KILL SWITCH ENGAGED
steps: All Altium MCP calls are now blocked and the MCP server processes were stopped.
Altium itself was NOT touched. Save your work in Altium. If a script is running press Ctrl+F3 there.
Restart any open Claude Code session before using it again.
To re-enable later, double-click REARM.cmd in the workspace folder.

kill_rearmed.title: Kill switch released
steps: The MCP configuration was restored. Nothing was started.
Start a new Claude Code session in the workspace folder to load the servers again.
